Waxay bilaabayaan qaabeynta — xubnaha rasmiga ah waxaa la dooran doonaa marka mashiinka doorashadu soo baxo Wejiga 2 ee khariidadda guud.
setup_step4_confirm.we_ll_record_setup_c: Waxaan diiwaangelin doonaa setup_completed_at ee settings-ka instance-ka. Laga bilaabo halkan /setup waxay kuu redirect-gareynaysaa bogga hore.
setup_step4_confirm.what_happens_when_yo: Maxaa dhaca marka aad gujiso Dhameystir
setup_step4_confirm.your_instance_is_set: Instance-kaaga waa la rakibay. Golayaasha sharci-dejinta waa la cabbiray, degmooyinka waa la sawiray, hay'adaha fulinta + garsoorkana waa la dhigay oo waxay sugayaan doorashadooda ugu horreysa. Ku soo dhawaada dastuurkaaga caddaaladda ah.
